@@U03929@@
behold me now, a youth in arms. Leagued with the strong, the bold, the free, in spirit I have proved my worth. Come! Let’s be off! The road stretches out to glory.

@@U03931@@
Scarcely born to life, scarcely known to light, you strive to dizzy heights, seeking scenes of strife and pain. Are we nothing, nothing to you, then? Was it a dream, our lovely union?
translation:
@@U03929@@
现在看我，一个武装的青年。与坚强、勇敢、自由的人结盟，我在精神上证明了自己的价值。来！我们出发吧！道路一直延伸到荣耀。

@@U03931@@
刚刚出生，几乎不为光明所知，你努力达到令人晕眩的高度，寻找冲突和痛苦的场景。那么我们对你来说什么都不是吗？我们可爱的结合是一场梦吗？
